policy_presence.summary: The 2026–27 IP Paris M1/M2 regulation contains explicit AI assessment rules. This establishes scoped guidance, not a university-wide AI policy.

ai_disclosure.summary: The 2026–27 Master rules require systematic, precise and detailed disclosure for permitted non-exam AI support; examination citation follows academic citation rules. Citation alone does not authorize use.

coursework.summary: For IP Paris M1/M2 in 2026–27, outside examinations AI support is described for information search, knowledge deepening and reasoning checks, subject to full disclosure, plagiarism restrictions and explicit instructor bans. Member-school/course conditions remain separate.

exams.summary: AI use in any examination requires explicit instructor authorization in the applicable instructions. This is limited to the covered 2026–27 Master scope.

privacy_data_entry.summary: The Master regulation requires confidentiality for scientific, technical and institutional information. It does not establish AI vendor training, retention or student account controls.

academic_integrity.summary: For 2026–27 IP Paris M1/M2, unauthorized exam AI use is fraud and reproduction beyond duly cited short excerpts is plagiarism. Academic penalties and disciplinary jurisdiction are stated separately; no numerical appeal deadline is established.

approved_tools.summary: No student product access, procurement, cost or endorsement is established by this review. Teacher-facing resources are not student access or assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: The covered Master text names ChatGPT, MistralAI and Gemini as LLM examples. Naming them establishes neither approved student access nor assessment permission.

teaching_guidance.summary: École polytechnique’s instructor resource catalogue lists Turnitin, AI Text Classifier and GPTZero, including a Moodle authenticity workflow. This is teacher-facing resource guidance, not a detector accuracy finding or student permission.

research_guidance.summary: The regulation states confidentiality duties for Master research and thesis information; broader thesis, publication and third-party service conditions remain unverified.

security_procurement.summary: No reviewed direct AI security-review, procurement, licensing or student vendor approval rule is established in this candidate.

policy_presence.summary: University academic integrity and institutional-data guidance exist, with different program procedures and tool-specific conditions.

coursework.summary: Follow the actual course and assignment instructions. Open, Conditional and Closed are instructor examples, not blanket student permission. Feinberg MD assignments require direct authorship unless specifically permitted; the Kellogg 2025–26 rule is historical.

exams.summary: Unauthorized examination aids are prohibited. The reviewed current university guidance does not establish one AI default for every exam; follow the instructor and school rules. The Kellogg 2025–26 manual must not be assumed current.

ai_disclosure.summary: Work submitted under your name needs proper attribution and authorization. Follow the task’s disclosure format; detailed prompt/verification lists in teaching examples are not a universal checklist, and citation does not authorize prohibited use.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Use only the validated tool, intended use and applicable data-provider permission. Feinberg clinical PHI guidance, its MD policy, McCormick Level 3 ban and Pritzker’s some-Level-3 allowance have distinct scopes. No-training assurances do not remove sensitive-data or retention limits.

academic_integrity.summary: Unauthorized AI authorship may be cheating or plagiarism. Part C response, possible sanctions and appeals apply only to listed schools; professional schools differ. TGS’s written-decision appeal period and initial-notification finality wording must remain separate.

approved_tools.summary: Copilot Chat is available through Northwestern accounts; paid M365 Copilot and school-funded ChatGPT/Claude seats have different eligibility. The SSO tool catalog remains unverified, and access never grants assessment permission.

named_ai_services.summary: Named Microsoft, ChatGPT and Claude offerings are documented for specific institutional accounts or school workspaces. Consumer, Team, Enterprise, Business and Premium modes are not interchangeable.

teaching_guidance.summary: Instructors can choose and communicate AI course policies; the Open/Conditional/Closed examples and Fall 2026 smart-glasses wording are recommendations. AI grading involving protected student information needs the stated agreements and security review.

research_guidance.summary: Panopto should not be used for non-public research data in the interview-transcription guidance. Other research recording, IRB and sponsor conditions require separate checks; Feinberg MD publication/presentation disclosure follows journal or organization requirements.

security_procurement.summary: Institutional data use requires the intended-use validation and data-provider permission in IT guidance. Protected grading data and school workspaces have additional agreements/restrictions; a catalog listing or no-training statement does not itself approve a use case.
